name: Monk Mystic Vocalist
body:
Mystic vocalists invest their energy in harnessing the power of their voice to damage, daze, and startle their opponents.

A mystic vocalist has the following class features.

Class Skills

A mystic vocalist adds Knowledge (arcana) and Linguistics to his list of class skills, and removes Ride.

This alters class skills.

Vocal Assault (Su)

At 5th level, a mystic vocalist can make a vocal assault a number of times per day equal to 1 + 1/2 his Wisdom modifier (minimum 1, rounded down). For every four levels beyond 5th, a mystic vocalist gains one additional use of this ability per day, to a maximum of 4 + 1/2 his Wisdom modifier at 17th level. Only one vocal assault can be attempted per round. The following are the different types of vocal assaults that become available to a mystic vocalist at specified levels: sound burst (5th level), ear-piercing scream (7th level), screech (10th level), thundering drums (13th level).

To use this ability, a mystic vocalist must forgo any one of his attacks in the round (regardless of whether the attack is part of a flurry of blows or not), substituting a vocal assault instead. In place of the attack forfeited, a mystic vocalist names the vocal assault he wishes to use and attempts a melee touch attack against the target. If the attack is successful, the target suffers the effects as stated in the vocal assault’s description. Regardless of the range or targets listed in the description of the vocal assault, only the target of the mystic vocalist’s melee touch attack is affected.

For the purpose of determining the saving throw DC and amount of damage inflicted, use the mystic vocalist’s monk level. This is a supernatural ability which uses only the mystic vocalist’s voice- no other components are necessary to create the effects of the vocal assaults.

This replaces style strike.

Varied Progression

At 9th level, a mystic vocalist gains tongue of the sun and moon. At 13th level, he gains improved evasion.

This alters the levels at which tongue of the sun and moon and improved evasion are gained.

Sonic Supremacy (Sp)

At 14th level, a mystic vocalist can cast echolocation and primal scream once each per day as spell-like abilities, with a caster level equal to his mystic vocalist level. At 17th level, a mystic vocalist can cast resonating word as a spell-like ability one per day.

This replaces the bonus feat gained at 14th level and timeless body.
